description: The same rules as Fleetwright's own renovate.json, for the files that moved
here from its install/runner-central/: pin every version, let a release
soak three days before proposing it, and never hold a security fix.
The Claude Code CLI a runner installs is pinned in two places, the shared
action and the Windows workflow, and kept current by the regex manager
below. Unpinned, every runner took whatever was latest that morning, and
the fleet ran a different version from the image it is supposed to mirror.
